description: Shows or hides the question area of the live room, so participants can ask questions during the webinar or cannot. Take it when the room should be quiet or open for questions. A host says: "I do not want questions this time, hide the box." It needs the session, the webinar and the status. It writes on your site, every participant sees the change on the next load, and questions already asked stay stored. Nothing else on the campaign changes. To read and answer the questions, see wi_get_webinar_questions and wi_answer_webinar_question. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: questions on or off, hide the question box, ask questions, Q and A

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

status.description: show puts the question area in the room, hide takes it out.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_change_webinar_qa
title: Switch the live questions on or off
